_comment: Worker-class manifest, renders prompts/mr-review/quick.md. The QUICK review tier (tiered MR review): the broker-side tier selector (routing.select_mr_review_tier) picks this prompt_class instead of mr-review/agent when the MR's diff is low-risk (small, and an allowlist-only match: plain prose docs by extension or tests-only, nothing executable/prompt-shaped, no sensitive-path hit). Same read-only grant, same {status,summary,wake} PASS/BLOCK output contract (constraints/mr-review + outputs/mr-review, unchanged) as the full reviewer; only the scope module is lighter: a 'does this break anything?' sanity check instead of a full adversarial audit, sized for a cheap model (default haiku). Content is operator-gated: the rendered prompt's sha256 must be signed into approved-prompts.json by the operator before it runs.
